name: Highcharts Dashboards KPI Component
self_contained_notes: Pulls in the Highcharts runtime (~200 KB); violates the self-contained requirement unless vendored.
similarity_notes: Solves exactly the value+label+delta KPI widget problem. Used as a structural reference, not as a vendored dependency.

name: ApexCharts
self_contained_notes: Ships a charting runtime; violates self-containment unless vendored (~150 KB).
similarity_notes: Provides KPI-style tiles and SVG scatter with built-in tooltip+zoom. Useful as a visual reference.

name: Carbon Design System - Stat tile
self_contained_notes: The technique (dl-based semantic structure with aria-label) is portable to vanilla HTML; the React component itself is not vendored.
similarity_notes: Closest accessible-by-default KPI tile reference; the dl/dt/dd pattern is exactly what the chosen technique adopts.

name: Plotly Python - ROC and PR curves
self_contained_notes: Plotly runtime is multi-hundred KB; violates self-containment.
similarity_notes: Renders both curves with threshold hover, AUC-shaded area, chance diagonal. Reference for the trapezoidal-area convention.

name: scikit-learn RocCurveDisplay / PrecisionRecallDisplay
self_contained_notes: Server-side Matplotlib raster; not a front-end dependency. Reference for the convention only.
similarity_notes: Canonical Python rendering of ROC/PR with the (0,0) prepended threshold point and step convention.

name: D3 d3-shape (line, curveStepAfter)
self_contained_notes: Vendoring d3-shape alone is ~12 KB; feasible but adds a second vendored library alongside d3-lite-force.js.
similarity_notes: d3.line().curve(d3.curveStepAfter) is the canonical step-function path generator. Rejected as a candidate because the step can be achieved with raw H/V path commands.

name: D3 d3-scale-chromatic
self_contained_notes: Vendoring the colour function (~2 KB) is cheap; vendoring all of d3-scale-chromatic is unnecessary.
similarity_notes: De-facto standard perceptually-uniform CVD-friendly ramps (interpolateViridis, interpolateCividis).

name: Crameri Scientific Colour Maps
self_contained_notes: A 256-stop lookup table is ~4 KB to inline.
similarity_notes: Perceptually uniform, CVD-friendly, grayscale-safe. vik diverging map recommended for signed deviations.

name: Carbon Design System - Data Table
self_contained_notes: The table+aria-sort technique is portable; the React component is not vendored.
similarity_notes: Native <table> with th scope, aria-sort on sortable headers, conditional cell colouring. Reference for the table rebuild.

name: Carbon Design System - Timeline
self_contained_notes: The ol/li + aria-current technique is portable.
similarity_notes: Accessible-by-default timeline using ol with li items carrying aria-current on the active step.

name: GitHub commit history timeline
self_contained_notes: Not a library; reference for the keyboard interaction model only.
similarity_notes: Semantic ol of commits with keyboard-navigable rows and aria-current on the selected commit. j/k or arrow-key navigation model.

name: Sergi Mansilla vanilla virtual list
self_contained_notes: ~100-line vanilla JS virtual list with no dependencies.
similarity_notes: Reference for the virtualization technique if the timeline ever exceeds ~500 entries.

name: D3 d3-force (full)
self_contained_notes: Vendoring d3-force alone is ~12 KB but depends on d3-quadtree, d3-dispatch, d3-timer. Vendoring all of D3 is ~270 KB.
similarity_notes: Reference implementation: Barnes-Hut many-body, Verlet integration, configurable forces. Candidate for the follow-up upgrade if the network exceeds 500 nodes.

name: Cytoscape.js
self_contained_notes: ~400 KB minified; too heavy for the self-contained constraint.
similarity_notes: Full graph-theory library with own layout engines. Reference for the interaction model (pan/zoom, edge-handle labels, accessibility).

name: vis-network
self_contained_notes: ~300 KB canvas-rendered; too heavy.
similarity_notes: Fastest path to an interactive network canvas per the PkgPulse 2026 comparison. Reference only.

name: Sigma.js
self_contained_notes: WebGL-rendered, designed for 10k+ node graphs; massive overkill for ~100 nodes.
similarity_notes: Mentioned only to bracket the 'use a real library' alternative at the heavy end.

name: d3-lite-force.js (project's own vendored helper)
self_contained_notes: Already vendored; 88 lines, 3268 bytes. The candidate the v1 already chose.
similarity_notes: Hand-rolled O(N^2) charge force with Verlet integration, spring forces, centering, 170 fixed iterations. Sufficient for ~100 nodes / 260 edges.

name: Vega-Lite
self_contained_notes: Vega-Lite runtime is ~400 KB; too heavy.
similarity_notes: Declarative scatter with zoom/pan/brush, color encodings, SVG renderer with Canvas fallback above a threshold. Reference for the interaction model.

name: dc.js scatter-canvas-large example
self_contained_notes: dc.js runtime is ~100 KB; the example is a reference for the hybrid SVG+Canvas technique.
similarity_notes: Maintained example that explicitly renders large scatters to Canvas for performance while keeping SVG for axes. Reference for the hybrid technique.

name: D3 d3-polygon (polygonHull)
self_contained_notes: Vendoring d3-polygon is ~2 KB; alternatively reimplement Andrew's monotone chain in ~40 lines of vanilla JS.
similarity_notes: Canonical convex-hull function (Andrew's monotone chain, O(n log n)). Reference for replacing the bounding-ellipse approximation.

name: ag-Grid (community edition)
self_contained_notes: ~330 KB minified; too heavy for the self-contained constraint.
similarity_notes: De-facto enterprise data grid. Row virtualization, 100k+ rows, full ARIA grid pattern with arrow-key navigation and aria-sort. Reference for the virtualization technique and accessibility pattern.

name: Tabulator
self_contained_notes: ~120 KB; lighter than ag-Grid but still too heavy for self-containment.
similarity_notes: Lighter vanilla-JS data grid with built-in pagination, virtualization, ARIA grid roles. Closest drop-in reference; rejected as a candidate because it imposes its own URL scheme on the deep-link convention.

name: SHAP (Python library + waterfall plot)
self_contained_notes: Python library; renders to matplotlib SVG. The technique (signed horizontal bars sorted by magnitude) is portable to inline SVG.
similarity_notes: Canonical feature-attribution waterfall. Reference for what a real waterfall looks like; the v1 explorer's waterfall is a simpler positive-only grouped bar chart.

name: ELI5
self_contained_notes: Python library; renders HTML tables with inline weight bars. The technique is directly portable.
similarity_notes: Renders a horizontal HTML table of features with a weight bar (div width=NN%), positive weights green, negative red. Closest structural reference for the explainability-atlas table rebuild.

name: LIME
self_contained_notes: Python library; the diverging-bar technique is portable.
similarity_notes: Renders a horizontal bar chart of feature contributions (positive right, negative left of a centre line). Reference for the diverging-bar technique.
